about: What a change to the network's rules decides differently: the lines that assets/rulefacts.js (the box on /proposals/ and /history/) and infra/alerts/rulefacts.py (the Telegram posts) must both write. `spec` is the genesis rule text, `before` revisions in force before the change, `revisions` the change; `streams` says per changed output whether it was read (same / changed) or why not. Checked by tests/rulefacts.mjs and infra/alerts/test_rulefacts.py.

cases.about: the base fee goes from 10 to 20
lines: Base fee per transaction · 10 AGRS → 20 AGRS: every transfer

        o7[t]:bv[16] = { 1 }:bv[16] : 
        o7[t]:bv[16] = { 0 }:bv[16]

).
